scheduled_maintenances.name: Network Maintenance in ORD
scheduled_maintenances.last_update_message: One of our upstream providers is conducting maintenance on a subset of our hosts in ORD on Tuesday, Oct 6th, 2026, from 09:00 - 11:00 UTC (04:00 - 06:00 CDT). Machines on affected hosts are expected to experience a total loss of connectivity for up to 30 minutes within the maintenance window.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Network Maintenance in EWR
scheduled_maintenances.last_update_message: One of our upstream providers is conducting maintenance on a subset of our hosts in EWR on 2026 Oct 2, from 20:00 UTC (14:00 local time) to 20:30 UTC (14:30 local time). No downtime is expected, but Machines on affected hosts may experience network flaps during the maintenance window.
